part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `lookupKey` (src/expire.c:842): the TOUCH exemption for no-touch clients checked `access_client->cmd` (the top-level command, e.g. `EVAL`), so `TOUCH` invoked via `redis.call()` inside a script was never exempted and `LOOKUP_NOTOUCH` suppressed the LRU update.

The fix checks the command that is actually performing the lookup (`server.executing_client->cmd`, falling back to `access_client`), matching the upstream resolution of valkey-io/valkey#1499, while keeping the caller-owned `no_touch` policy lookup via `scriptGetCaller()`.

Validated in the container:
- `unit/introspection-2` — all pass, including "TOUCH alters the last access time of a key in no-touch mode" and "Operations in no-touch mode do not alter the last access time of a key"
- `unit/scripting`, `unit/functions`, `unit/expire`, `unit/keyspace`, `unit/type/string` — all pass
